notes.title: The Warbound Era Begins! 🛡️
notes.content:
📜 To the Noble Kings and Queens of the Realm,

The banners of Warbound have been raised, and the call to battle echoes across the land! With passion as our shield and creativity as our sword, we have forged a game that will challenge your strategy and test your resolve.

📅 Steam Page Live: 18th January at 10:30 AM!

⚔️ What is Warbound?
- A dynamic RTS game combining real-time strategy with deckbuilding brilliance.
- Lead powerful armies, expand your kingdom, and leave your mark on history.
- With roguelike mechanics, no two battles will ever be the same!

🏰 Words from the Spies
Our spies bring word from distant lands—heroes are stirring. These mighty champions, with unmatched skills, prepare to join the fray. Stay tuned for future updates through our letters!

In loyal service to the realm,
⚔️ The Warbound Team ⚔️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3119640
